sections.title: Mental model
sections.body:
Frontend auth has three tracks:

- **Session cookies** — httpOnly + Secure + SameSite=Lax.
- **Token-based** — short-lived access tokens, refresh tokens.
- **OAuth2 / OIDC** — auth code + PKCE for SPAs.

**Never store tokens in localStorage** if you can avoid it — XSS-readable.

sections.title: Must-know concepts
sections.body:
The interview surface for this module breaks into these focus areas:

- **Jwt storage localstorage vs cookie** — drill the named patterns, the failure modes, and the recommended Java / framework idiom.
- **Oauth2 flows pkce and code** — drill the named patterns, the failure modes, and the recommended Java / framework idiom.
- **Oidc and id tokens** — drill the named patterns, the failure modes, and the recommended Java / framework idiom.
- **Sso saml flows** — drill the named patterns, the failure modes, and the recommended Java / framework idiom.
- **Refresh tokens and silent renew** — drill the named patterns, the failure modes, and the recommended Java / framework idiom.
- **Session management and logout** — drill the named patterns, the failure modes, and the recommended Java / framework idiom.
- **Xss csrf frontend defenses** — drill the named patterns, the failure modes, and the recommended Java / framework idiom.
- **Secure cookie flags** — drill the named patterns, the failure modes, and the recommended Java / framework idiom.
- **Scenario-based** — applied questions tying multiple topics together. Drill these *last*, after the fundamentals are sharp.

sections.title: Likely interview hooks
sections.body:
- **PKCE** — proof key for code exchange; mandatory for public SPAs.
- **Silent refresh** — iframe-based or refresh-token rotation.
- **CSRF + cookies** — `SameSite=Lax` mostly defends; double-submit token if not.
- **Logout** — clear the cookie *and* revoke the refresh token.
- **Federated identity** — Auth0 / Cognito / Okta abstract a lot, but you still own the redirect handling.

sections.title: Speaking template
sections.body: > *"I'd use OIDC auth-code + PKCE, store the access token in memory (not localStorage), refresh via httpOnly cookie, set `SameSite=Lax` for CSRF, and revoke on logout server-side. Federated via Auth0 keeps the auth surface minimal in our code."*
